query: UPDATE photos SET status=$2::text::photo_status, failure_reason=CASE WHEN $2='failed' THEN 'fixture failure' END, taken_at=$3,taken_at_local=$3 AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',taken_at_override=CASE WHEN $4 THEN $3 END, gps_lat=43,gps_lon=-79,gps_overridden=$4,place_id=$5,place_overridden=$4,deleted_at=CASE WHEN $6 THEN now() END WHERE id=$1
